correctness.rationale: The periodic edge-contact budget yields the exact adjacency-time identity under the half-degree hypothesis; temporal Fourier eigenvalue algebraic-integrality rules out every nonzero recurrent mode on Paley(q) for all q>=13, including nonsquare and square prime powers. Orders 5 and 9 are analytically reduced to two five-cycles and four three-cycles. Two independent full-state enumerators exhaustively confirm the stated basin and first-entry counts, with output and code supplied.

value.rationale: A complete natural infinite-family classification of persistent critical-threshold excitation, with sharp exceptional orders 5 and 9, links arithmetic eigenvalue integrality to nonlinear recurrence. Exact exceptional attraction basins reveal that Paley(9) has only isolated wave cycles whereas Paley(5) waves attract nonperiodic configurations; this qualitative boundary is motivated by the critical half-degree dynamics, not an arbitrary slice.
